question: According to 2011 Census, among the following which state has the lowest sex ratio?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Based on the 2011 census the total human population in Haryana state is 25351462.

 
 
• The population of Haryana forms 2.09% of India in 2011.
 
• Population Density: 573/Km2.
 
• Population Density rank: 11.
 
• Male population: 13494734.
 
• Female population: 11856728.
 
• Population density (Total, Persons per sq km): 573.
 
• Sex ratio (Females per 1000 males): 879 (879/1000).
 
• Sex ratio in Rural areas: 882/1000.
 
• Sex ratio in Urban areas: 873/1000.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sex Ratio in India:

 
 
• Sex ratio is used to describe the number of females per 1000 of males.
 
• Sex ratio is a valuable source for finding the population of women in India and what is the ratio of women to that of men in India.
 
• In the Population Census of 2011, it was revealed that the population ratio in India 2011 is 943 females per 1000 males.
 
• The Sex Ratio 2011 shows an upward trend from the census 2001 data.
 
• Census 2001 revealed that there were 933 females to that of 1000 males.
 
• For decades India has seen a decrease in the sex ratio 2011, but since the last two of the decades, there has been a slight increase in the sex ratio.
 
• Since the last five decades, the sex ratio has been moving from around 930 females to that of 1000 males.
